title: Expertise France — Libya digital skills training (Raqameyon), 2023
description: "This new project came as a continuation of its predecessor project, 'Raqam-e', also funded by France and implemented by Expertise France... Based on the Libyan need to upgrade their digital skills and keep up with technological development to enter the era of digital transformation, Raqameyon project will build on the lessons learned from the preceding project, Raqam-e..." The project supports four actions: "Pack Office" digital-skills training for public/private employees and women; supporting the Ministry of Education's deployment of digital training in 5 schools; digital-skills training for entrepreneurs and SMEs; and expert training depending on partner needs. Expected results include 2,160 people trained in Microsoft tools, 8 teachers and 2 Ministry of Education agents trained to deliver a digital training platform, 240 entrepreneurs trained, and 320 hours of training delivered.
recipient_organisation: Libya (national programme; no single named recipient organisation)
